summary: Independently reproduced the original token-versus-page metric mismatch on the recorded base and verified exact candidate d1822c9272066f86263a87de1c8f7bfb39abce3e. The candidate passes page_size from the scheduler's sole production constructor call site and computes both block metrics from max_total_num_tokens // page_size. The reported example, candidate regression, adjacent tests, and six independent boundary cases pass. This is a full production fix with regression coverage, not test-only hardening or an unverified claim.

tests.what_was_measured: The checked-out source module emitted kv_total_blocks=8192 and kv_active_blocks=4096 for max_total_num_tokens=8192 and token_usage=0.5, versus independent page_size=16 references of 512 and 256.
Candidate regression passed: 1 test and 4 subtests covering the reported page_size=16 case, page_size=1 compatibility, zero usage, and a partial trailing page.
All six independent references matched, including 8192/16 at 50%, page_size=1, non-divisible capacities, capacity smaller than page size, fractional usage truncation, and page_size=32.
Adjacent coverage passed: 16 tests and 22 subtests.
All changed Python source and test files compiled.
The candidate's committed raw pytest logs contain trailing whitespace, contrary to its PR prose; production and test source were not implicated.

gpu_execution.evidence: rocminfo and rocm-smi identify the assigned single GPU as AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. GPU execution was not used because the original contract is CPU-side metric arithmetic and message construction; no unrelated GPU smoke is presented as proof.

remaining_limitations: No full serving/model or multi-node run was performed; weights, semantic accuracy, transport, and distributed behavior are outside this arithmetic metric defect.
No C++/HIP/native files changed and repository-environment.json reports native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The candidate's complete diff fails git diff --check only in retained raw pytest logs; this is a non-functional evidence-formatting issue.
